item.title: Sharp and immediate fall! Yes Bank share price crash 10% after SC ruling on ₹8,415 crore AT-1 bond write-off

item.title: 70% YTD returns! Axis Capital sees 30% more upside in this renewable power stock; do you own? Target price
item.description: As per the BSE data, the stock has jumped 72% year-to-date, while on a shorter timeframe of six months, it has climbed 43%. It hit a 52-week high of ₹476.40 on 22 September after hitting a 52-week low of ₹195.65 on 27 January.

item.title: For BHEL, a muted order inflow upset the apple cart
item.description: BHEL's shares fell 5% on Thursday, after hitting a new 52-week high on Wednesday. The U-turn in investor sentiment was in reaction to order inflows sliding to multi-quarter low.
